messages:
Liam Torres: Quick Q — can I add my mom to my medical/dental? She just moved in and I'm paying >50% of her expenses. What's required? Is this a QLE?

Aisha (People Ops): Short answer: plan eligibility is driven by our insurer. Most employer medical/dental plans only allow spouse/domestic partner and children as dependents. Parents are usually not eligible. Tax dependency (IRS rules) is a separate thing.

Priya (Benefits): @Liam if you meet the IRS "qualifying relative" tests (you provide >50% support, her gross income below the IRS threshold, she isn't filing jointly, etc.) that helps with tax treatment, but it doesn't guarantee the carrier will accept her as a plan dependent. Some voluntary vendors (AD&D, critical illness) have different rules — we'll check.

Aisha (People Ops): If you want us to investigate, here's what we'll need: 1) Proof of relationship (birth certificate or other official doc), 2) Proof of support (bank transfers, bills paid, rent/utilities in your name), 3) Proof of residence (mail or lease), and 4) A short note describing the situation. Send to benefits@redwood.com with subject "Parent coverage inquiry" and we'll open a case with the insurer rep. Note: moving in / paying for care by itself is NOT a qualifying life event for adding dependents outside open enrollment unless the parent loses other coverage.

Liam Torres: Ok — thanks. If the insurer says no, are there other benefit options for elder care support?

Priya (Benefits): We have an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) that includes eldercare resources and referrals. There's also a pilot backup-care stipend for dependent care (depends on eligibility). Dependent Care FSA typically only covers qualifying dependents per IRS rules — consult a tax advisor before assuming reimbursements. I'll DM you links to the EAP and the backup-care form.

Aisha (People Ops): FYI — timeline: if insurer approves mid-year, they may still require an enrollment change during open enrollment or after a QLE. If not approved, you can enroll any eligible dependents during open enrollment (next window Nov 1–15). Ping me and we'll start the inquiry. :slightly_smiling_face:

people-ops-bot: Reminder — open enrollment window Nov 1–15. Changes made during open enrollment take effect Jan 1.
